**Resubmitted: deviation (WARRANTY) — dangling cross-reference repaired.**

What changed from the prior submission:

- **Root cause of the intent defect:** the subparagraph number was supplied only in the `numbering` metadata field, which the renderer dropped, so the inserted warranty appeared unnumbered while both carve-outs pointed to "Subparagraph 4.10".
- **Fix:** the number is now carried in the operative text itself — the inserted paragraph begins "4.10 The PG warrants to each other Party that…". Both carve-outs in p0126 and p0127 therefore resolve to a real subparagraph, and the retained closing words of 4.9 ("nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as such a warranty or guarantee") can no longer be read to negate the new warranty.
- **Nothing else altered:** the two carve-out replaces are unchanged and still preserve every untouched word of 4.8 and 4.9 verbatim; no survival tail, procedure, expense or damages language was added; the minimality gate returned ok:true.
- **Element coverage (fallback, unchanged and all in operative language):** 90-day software conformance to documentation; 30-day services warranty; repair or replacement; refund of fees paid. Preferred remains unmet by design (90 days rather than 12 months, 30 rather than 90 days, no workmanlike or malicious-code warranty), consistent with targeting the shortest complete fallback cure.
